login.title: RiskSense AI

branch.invalid: Branch trigger must be an object.

thresholds.range: {classification} must use whole numbers from 0 to 100, with maximum not below minimum.

confidence.invalid: Confidence gates must be an object.

policy.title: Sessions & retention
policy.accountSemantics: One person uses one account with exactly one role. Session settings control access to that account, not extra roles.
policy.sessionSemantics: This limits simultaneous devices or browser sessions for one account; it does not create another account or role.
policy.retentionFixed: FREE uses the fixed public retention windows shown below. Switch to PAID before configuring customer-specific windows.
policy.retentionConfigurable: PAID retention windows are tenant-configurable. Enforcement remains staged, audited, and non-destructive to audit logs.
policy.datasetHistorySemantics: Dataset history starts when a version is retired. The value is the number of days retained after retirement—an explicit replacement for ‘life + 3 years.’
policy.description: FREE reduces expired records to essential metadata; PAID archives them first. Enforcement runs nightly and is audited.

retention.title: Retention policy configuration
retention.description: Configure data retention periods and automatic expiry actions.

policy.freeDescription: FREE uses the public retention windows shown in Tenant settings. Expired records are reduced after the seven-day grace period.
policy.paidDescription: PAID windows can be configured per tenant. Full records are archived before the live copy is reduced.

policyTable.title: Retention policy
